description: Radio buttons allow the user to select a single option from a group using a button-like control.Radio buttons are designed to be used with radio groups. When a radio button has focus, the arrow keys can be used to change the selected option just like standard radio controls.
title: Default

description: To set the initial value and checked state, use the value attribute on the containing radio group.
title: Checked

description: The focus event gives the user feedback that the radio button has been focused by the keyboard interaction.
title: Focus

description: Set disabled on an unavailable radio-button option and explain why it cannot be selected. Use readonly on every option when the current selection is for inspection only.
title: Disabled

description: Set readonly on every syn-radio-button in the group to show the current selection without allowing changes. Setting it only on the selected option leaves other buttons available.
title: Readonly

description: Use the size attribute to change a radio button’s size.
title: Sizes

description: The invalid status is used to warn the user that the Radio Group is invalid. For example, if the radio-button is mandatory and nothing has been checked.
title: Invalid

description: Use the prefix and suffix slots to add icons.
title: Prefix And Suffix Icons

description: You can omit button labels and use icons instead. Make sure to set a label attribute on each icon so screen readers will announce each option correctly.
title: Buttons With Icons
